newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian retail trend weakest in 35 years.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian retail trend weakest in 35 years.

text.p: The trend in Australian retail trade is at its weakest in the 35 year history of the series, Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) data showed.
The monthly trend series has fallen in each of the five months up to December, and has been at negative 0.3 percent for the last three months.
"The closest we came to it was a period in July to September 1992 when there was zero growth (in trend terms)," an ABS spokesman said.

The trend, a centred moving average, smooths out month-to-month bumps in the seasonally adjusted data. While the trend is subject to revision, usually it is only the latest three months that change significantly.

The spokesman said it was possible that a preliminary trend estimate at some point in the past had shown negative growth, but if so it had been revised in the trend series, which up until now had shown almost continual upward movement.
